title: Regression Safety
description: Use for changes near existing behavior. Covers preserving known working behavior and surfacing truthful loading/error/unavailable states instead of false success.

requirements.statement: Preserve known working behavior around the changed area; any intentional behavior change outside the assigned scope must be called out with rationale and proof.
Do not mask real missing permissions, unavailable services, failed dependencies, or invalid state as success/empty data; surface truthful loading/error/unavailable states with actionable context.
